ghidra: read-only: no rename, comment, prototype, function creation or save
headline: The group think is two passes on two clocks, both hung off 00A32D50, a 20-byte routine Ghidra has no function for: 00A2E720 composes groups every fixed step at 20 Hz, and 00A182C0 -> 00A181A0 runs one party's commander on a 3-to-5-second jittered timer. Neither 00A2DB80 nor 00A2EEE0, the two routines the brief named as the think, is on a think path.

corrections.was: group+10h is the member list head, because 00A2D8E0 links the entity there
corrections.is: group+10h is the group's observer subobject with vtable 00D2306C; the member list is group+563Ch (std::list object), its sentinel node group+5640h and its size group+5644h
corrections.evidence: 00A2DFCD stores 00CE3CD4 at +10h and 00A2DFEB overwrites it with 00D2306C, a five-slot table (00A2D570, 00A2DA60, 00A2BD40, 00A2DB50, 0042B140). 00A2D8FD is LEA EDX,[ESI+0x10] feeding 00694A60 BSP_Observer_RegisterPair at 00A2D906, and 00A2E3B9/00A2E3BE pass the same +10h to 006956A0 to undo it. The list is built at 00A2DFF2-00A2E027: LEA EBX,[ESI+563Ch], CALL 004C1630, [EBX+4]=EAX, [EBX+8]=0.

corrections.was: the 00F8A8BC defend-percent array and the 1Ch records at 00F8A8C8 are not disjoint for slots 3 and above (flagged as unresolved)
corrections.is: the Defend_ResourcePercent array is exactly three dwords, indexed by difficulty 0..2, and the globals loader guards the index so it never overflows; only the unguarded Lua setter can reach the collision
corrections.evidence: 00A16B46 bounds the brain array with CMP EDI,0xF8A8BC and 00A182EE starts the party records at EBP = 0xF8A8C8 with stride 1Ch and bound 0xF8A9A8, so only three dwords lie between. 00A360F5 is CMP EDI,3 / JGE 00A3613E, skipping the store at 00A36126 for modes 3..6; EDI's only writes before that store are XOR EDI,EDI at 00A3374B and ADD EDI,1 at 00A370D4 (whole-listing filter). The key string at 00D23500 is 'Defend_ResourcePercent'. 00A37E4B stores with ESI = 009FFC80() (0..6) and no bound check.

corrections.was: 00A2EEE0 is the AIGetGroupInfo fill routine, body not read (listed as a routine of that packet)
corrections.is: confirmed, and confirmed not to be a think: its only caller is 00A378C0 and its call set is Lua-object setters plus string builders, with no call site on any fixed-step path
corrections.evidence: ghidra xrefs 00A2EEE0 returns BSP_LuaBinding_AIGetGroupInfo @ 00A378C0 only. Its calls include 00B675D0, 00B67580, 00B67700, 00B67800, 00B666C0, 00B673A0, 0041E870, 0041DD40, 00BF7680. The fixed-step path is 00A32D50 -> 00A2E720 and 00A182C0.

corrections.was: 00A2BD90 forwards both stack arguments to group+564Ch vtable[24h] (transcription correct, effect not stated)
corrections.is: that slot is 00A0FC90, RET 8, a no-op in every AI command class the group constructor installs, so the notification is discarded; 00A2BD90 is a hook, not a fan-out, and the group's real command distribution is 00A2DB80's retarget phase
corrections.evidence: 00A0FC90 disassembles to a single RET 8 on disk and Ghidra has no function there. It occurs sixteen times in .rdata, all inside 00D2298C-00D22C68, the AI-command vtable block; 00D22990, 00D229B8 and 00D229E0 all carry it at +24h, and 00A2E11C/00A2E13B/00A2E152 are the only three classes the constructor installs.

runtime_evidence: none. The fixed-step AI path is not on a path bsp_game.exe reaches: docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md's host tables cover the front end and the frame, not an in-mission AI coordinator, and no host in this repository implements AiGroupThinkHost. Every claim here is static.

tool_problems: bsp.py scan-bytes reports the address of the matched immediate operand, not the instruction start, and attributes it to the nearest preceding function even when the address lies past that function's body end (00A184FC, 00A18513 and 00A18524 were all reported 'in 00A182C0', whose body ends at 00A18402)
bsp.py ghidra callers returns 'No callers found for function: null' where ghidra xrefs finds the caller, for 00A2E720, 00A2E4C0 and 00A22920; xrefs is the reliable query
bsp.py ghidra export writes into the main checkout's exports/bsp, so a worktree-relative path to the listing does not exist and the absolute main-checkout path must be used
